commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' The attendance for today's match is 60000.
90+7' Bayern Munich get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.
90+7' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+3' It's like he was asking for a caution. Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) receives a yellow card.
90+3' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 1:3.
87' Substitution. Alphonso Davies will be replaced by Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich).
87' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) replaces Jamal Musiala.
87' Today's match ends for Michael Olise who will be replaced by Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich).
86' Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post.
85' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
81' Substitution. Jacob Bruun Larsen (VfB Stuttgart) in, Chris Fuhrich out.
81' Here is a change. Atakan Karazor is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart).
80' Shots on target – 3:6.
78' Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
77' A promising first-time strike from inside the box by Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich), but his attempt goes just wide of the target.
77' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
76' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
76' We are about to witness a substitution. Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) is replacing Konrad Laimer.

75' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the bottom left corner, but great anticipation by Alexander Nubel allowed him to make a comfortable save.
75' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
73' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
70' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Jeff Chabot and he is replaced by Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart).
70' A substitution has been made. Jamie Leweling goes off and Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
68' 45:55 – the latest ball possession ratio.
66' A yellow card for a tackle by Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich). Benjamin Brand doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
64' 1 - 2 Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) receives the ball after one of the defenders fails to make a clearance and sends the ball into the back of the net!

63' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Alexander Nubel thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
62' Substitution. Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) replaces Leroy Sane.
61' Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
61' Alexander Nubel leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich).
59' Yellow card. Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
59' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) and Konrad Laimer perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
56' A brilliant through ball from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) as he picks out Jamal Musiala, who darted into free space to take the pass.
52' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
51' Stuttgart enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
48' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) for a tough tackle.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Bayern Munich players have a reason to celebrate!
45+1' The Bayern Munich players halt their celebrations as referee Benjamin Brand makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' 1 - 1 Goal! Leroy Sane displays great vision and sends a pass to Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the left post. The score is 1:1.
44' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort only goes towards the middle of the goal and presents no problem for the goalkeeper.
43' Bayern Munich have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
42' The foul by Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Benjamin Brand.
41' 2:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
39' Finn Jeltsch (VfB Stuttgart) is punished with the yellow card.
34' 1 - 0 Goal! Josha Vagnoman plays a short, square pass into the path of Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart), who bends a shot straight into the top right corner to make it 1:0. Fabulous goal!
34' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Stuttgart.
31' A great pass puts Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the right post.
30' It seemed like Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
28' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker over the crossbar.
27' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
25' Manuel Neuer (Bayern Munich) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball has crossed the sideline. Stuttgart are taking a throw-in.
24' Stuttgart take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
22' Leroy Sane plays a lovely pass into Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
21' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) steps up to send the ball in.
19' Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
18' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) took the corner.
17' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) sends a killer pass through the opponent's defence in an effort to find a space for Nick Woltemade, who is lurking close to the offside line.
16' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom right corner is far too weak and Alexander Nubel makes a simple save.
15' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) will take a corner kick.
11' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Benjamin Brand signals.
9' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
8' It seemed like Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
6' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Manuel Neuer pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
4' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

3' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Good work from Bayern Munich as they win a corner.
